method_name_expansion: Resource-Aware MedFiLM with Benefit-Aware Refinement Routing
scientific_scope: A pre-registered design for a learned GT-free predictor of PAIRED REFINEMENT GAIN, evaluated BEFORE an optional expensive regional refinement, used for execute/skip routing inside a shared multi-domain medical-segmentation system, with a structural preservation fallback and an explicit resource-cost term in the decision utility.
contribution_type: SYSTEM / INTEGRATION contribution. Phase 23 established that each individual primitive (gate mechanism, paired-gain target, multi-domain sharing, resource awareness) is OCCUPIED. No novelty is claimed for any primitive.

global_reference.role: frozen anchor; produces the fallback output and the reusable features
global_reference.F_global: reusable intermediate features already produced by the global forward
global_reference.modification_policy: MUST NOT be modified during the initial controlled Phase-25 experiments. Any fine-tuning of the global model is a separate, later, explicitly authorised change.
global_reference.feature_reuse_requirement: The router MUST reuse F_global. A SECOND full Global MedFiLM forward purely to make the routing decision is FORBIDDEN: it would destroy the compute-saving claim (C4).

region_proposal.frozen_rule: p_global predicted foreground -> tight bounding box -> fixed context expansion -> clip to image -> square pad -> resize to regional-refiner resolution
region_proposal.constants_source: TRAIN only (context expansion factor, refiner resolution)
region_proposal.empty_global_prediction_justification: Option A (skip) is chosen as the PRIMARY prospective behaviour because it is the minimal, GT-free, zero-extra-cost rule: if the global model predicts no foreground, there is no region to refine and the global output is preserved by the fallback. Option B (deterministic cheap uncertainty-based rescue) is retained ONLY as a pre-registered controlled ablation, and any constant it uses must be derived from TRAIN only, frozen before Phase 25.

regional_refiner.must_not_be: the frozen Global MedFiLM checkpoint reused on resampled crops. Phase 22 showed that reuse was HARMFUL in aggregate.
regional_refiner.class: dedicated crop-trained lightweight residual U-Net / encoder-decoder

target_parameter_envelope.note: DESIGN TARGETS ONLY. Not implemented, not counted, not achieved.

regional_refiner.conditioning: task/domain embedding permitted; shared across domains
regional_refiner.fusion_role: its output is a CANDIDATE, never a replacement, until the final selection

benefit_router.job: estimate the expected PAIRED REFINEMENT GAIN before R_psi executes. It is NOT an uncertainty predictor.

compute_envelope.note: DESIGN TARGET ONLY; measured in Phase 25.

pre_execution_gate.rule: if U_hat_i > tau then EXECUTE else SKIP

post_safety.importance: This is the component closest to JFS. S_omega must NEVER be presented as the compute-saving mechanism, because JFS already occupies the post-hoc decision.
post_safety.mandatory_ablation: A7 (router, no post-safety) vs A8 (router + post-safety)

fusion_rule.primary: outside ROI retain p_global; inside ROI replace with p_refined

task_conditioning.primary_design: ONE shared router with task/domain conditioning allowed
task_conditioning.reason: preserve the shared multi-domain system contribution

training_stage_contract.stage_ordering_constraint: The benefit router may only be fitted AFTER out-of-fold gain labels exist (25C precedes 25D). The refiner must be cross-fitted, never fit and evaluated on the same samples.

crossfit_contract.procedure: For fold k: train R_psi on folds != k, infer R_psi on fold k, compute DeltaDice_i = Dice(R_i, GT) - Dice(G_i, GT) for fold-k samples.

hypotheses.H1: A learned pre-execution GT-free predictor of paired refinement gain can allocate optional regional refinement more effectively than simple GT-free uncertainty/geometry proxies at equal refinement-activation budgets.
hypotheses.H2: benefit-aware routing captures more positive gain per unit compute than random/entropy/margin/ROI-size routing.
hypotheses.H3: post-refinement fallback reduces harmful replacement relative to always accepting an executed refinement.
hypotheses.H4: a dedicated crop-trained regional refiner yields a more useful action distribution than the Phase-22 diagnostic reuse of the full-field model.
hypotheses.H5: benefit-aware routing produces a measurable accuracy-compute frontier.
hypotheses.H6: learned paired refinement gain contains information beyond ordinary global uncertainty.

routing: mean true DeltaDice among routed cases

preservation_margin.metric: Delta = Dice(final routed system) - Dice(global reference)
preservation_margin.warning: macro preservation must not hide severe domain-specific harm

forbidden_claims: performance preserving (until the frozen non-inferiority criterion is actually met)
current_allowed_wording: We specify a benefit-aware refinement-routing system...
level_2_wording_condition: Future Level-2 wording may be used only after empirical support and only for the exact integrated contribution identified by Phase 23.
